# Independent Qwen3.5 CPU hybrid fixture

Generated by [qwen35_cpu_graph.py](../../../tools/reference/qwen35_cpu_graph.py)
before the Rust model/session composition. The producer imports no Toklet,
MLX, Torch or NumPy implementation. Quantized words are low-first affine4/G64
with BF16 scale/bias; other source values are BF16. Names follow the selected
source, while dimensions deliberately form a tiny synthetic model.

Three delta/four-tap layers precede one full-attention layer. Query projection
width differs from hidden width, grouped delta and KV heads differ, and partial
rotary leaves an inactive suffix. Four input cases include position4,079 and a
future-token change. Separate ideal FP64 and staged FP32 profiles retain all
stages/state/logits under the existing1e-5+1e-4relative gate.

The manifest pins both binary bodies and each typed array. The Rust consumer
also pins the complete manifest SHA. These fixtures prove no real-source,
device, codec, quality or managed-adoption qualification.
